_description: config.local.json is automatically gitignored by .gw/.gitignore. The telemetry sub-object is deep-merged with config.json (local wins per field). 'enabled' here IS effective (per-machine consent). Put auth headers/secrets HERE, never in committed config.json. Alternatively, use 'gw telemetry on' to write just the enabled:true field.
_usage: Save as .gw/config.local.json. Add only the fields you want to override — the rest come from config.json.
